mentions.name: DonateYourGift
mentions.description: This app lets people ask gift-givers to donate to charities of their choosing instead of giving gifts on occasions like birthdays or Christmas.
mentions.problem: No single-focus tool existed for requesting charitable donations in lieu of birthday or Christmas gifts, so it was built to scratch the author's own itch.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built an app to enable this: http://donateyourgift.com/ It is very simple but I didn't find anything quite singly-focused like it, so I built it just to scratch my own itch.
